subject: general
question: Which Indian Ministry launched the Bharat Forecasting System (BFS) on 26 May 2025 to provide weather predictions with a 6-km resolution?

options.text: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change

solution: The correct answer is __**Ministry of Earth Sciences**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The **Bharat Forecasting System (BFS)** was launched by the **Ministry of Earth Sciences** on **26 May 2025** to enhance weather prediction capabilities in India. • This system provides **weather forecasts** with a high resolution of **6 kilometers**, which is a significant improvement over previous models. • The BFS enhances the prediction of **monsoons, cyclones, thunderstorms, and other weather events**, helping in disaster preparedness and mitigation. • The initiative aligns with the government's efforts to utilize advanced **numerical weather prediction models** and improve weather-related services. • The BFS was developed under the leadership of the **Indian Meteorological Department (IMD)**, a part of the Ministry of Earth Sciences, which is responsible for weather forecasting and climate research in India.
